scope: Bounded actual complete-operation root audit of exactly four frozen K40/W2 map/MM normal/compact timed ELFs, A6/B2 scalar/N4/N8 candidate plus ordinary/exact controls. No source/compiler edits, benchmarks, additional variants or transitive helper audit.
profile: Pinned Clang21, local armv8-a+simd/mtune generic, loop/SLP automatic vectorizers disabled. This is not native-host performance qualification.
findings: Compact source changes only internal hash-fact storage/encoding: primary/secondary raw fact planes of3*N words becomeN encoded words. Permutation input, bucket folding and selector math remain unchanged. Split-vector output uses encoded=(x with bucket bits replaced) XOR(selector<<A); lane access reconstructs bucket, suffix and fingerprint. Wire/table payload layouts and hierarchy geometry remain unchanged.

All36 read roots are call-free, including both candidate storage variants and ordinary/exact controls. Compact adds no lookup, consumer, packet decoder or result-buffer call boundary. The intentional24-byte answer aggregate is returned once per whole trace root.

Fused hot mutation is preserved: map read/store of incoming two-byte replacement and MM inline value/tag append are direct root instructions. Complete writes retain chain/bag acquire, insertion/growth, external-bag memcpy and cleanup/error paths. Candidate packet-write call inventories remain11 for map and27 for MM in both widths and variants; this is a static inventory, not per-operation calls.

Raw fact storage shrinks96→32B atN4 and192→64B atN8 for each primary/secondary fact set. Real stack frames fall beyond or around those raw deltas: map read656→448B /928→640B, MM read704→496B /992→672B. Map write576→432B /864→560B; MM write1008→880B /1312→992B. Scalar frames remain unchanged. These are fixed root SP allocations, not logical object sizes or transitive/concurrent peaks.

Read code decreases modestly while writes grow slightly: map N4/N8 read1960→1900B /2656→2600B, write3964→3984B /4864→4916B; MM read2132→2080B /2836→2768B, write7360→7480B /8456→8496B. Every candidate packet root retains the same static explicit SIMD widened-multiply inventory across storage variants; branch/path inventories and encoding/decoding costs still differ.

Actual point access changes from separate fact-plane loads to one encoded-fact load. Map N4 compact24888 loads one fact,24890 UBFIZ extracts/scales low6 bucket bits,248a0 shifts fingerprint6 and248ac shifts suffix14. Secondary uses the analogous low2/shift2/shift10 extraction. SIMD result/intermediate and owner/consumer state still spill; compact does not make the complete roots stack-free.

No-change controls are matched. All14 scalar-candidate/baseline read-control pairs have byte-identical ELF symbol contents. All14 write-control pairs have identical instruction/register/branch/helper structure after resolving code targets and ADRP+ADD pointers to exact symbols or identical literal strings. No new instructions, register-allocation or frame changes were found in those controls. Different linked placement remains; transitive helper bodies were not independently compared.

Lazy-secondary and fresh per-lane counts/locations remain the same scoped mechanism. Packing immutable facts does not cache mutable locations or consume fewer hierarchy tiers. The private representation change should not be described as a new public hash/permutation or data format.

Static code/frame/storage differences do not establish speedup, SIMD attribution or a batch policy. Source-equivalent/read-byte-identical controls can still exhibit timing variation due to measurement or linked placement; the data owner must assess that separately.

control_proof.normalization: Internal branch offsets and external call identities retained; ADRP+ADD targets resolved through exact ELF symbols or SHA256-identical C-string bytes. Remaining instructions/registers/immediates must match. This preserves actual instruction counts and does not erase register-allocation differences.
